title: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(3)
desc: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(3)

paragraphs.en: Zero-based budgeting rarely succeeds in cutting costs.
paragraphs.zh: 零基预算很少能成功削减成本。

paragraphs.en: Its real effect, in Musk's hands, was the concentration of power.
paragraphs.zh: 在马斯克手中，其真正效应是权力的集中。

paragraphs.en: His approach assumed that all expenditures were waste, and that bad data – whether fraudulent contracts, useless staff or illegitimate people – could simply be deleted.
paragraphs.zh: 他的方法假设所有支出都是浪费，而坏数据——无论是欺诈性合同、无用员工还是不合法人员——都可以直接删除。

paragraphs.en: What Doge sought to automate, the media researcher Eryk Salvaggio noted, was "not paperwork but democratic decision-making". Efficiency became the alibi for centralisation.
paragraphs.zh: 媒体研究员埃里克·萨尔瓦吉奥指出，政府效率部试图实现自动化的"不是文书工作，而是民主决策"。效率成了集权的借口。

paragraphs.en: This centralisation took material form in Doge's approach to data, which aimed to put all of the government's information into a single repository.
paragraphs.zh: 这种集中化在政府效率部处理数据的方式中得到了具体体现，其目标是将政府的所有信息都放入一个单一的存储库中。

paragraphs.en: Washington had pursued the dream of data integration since the post-9/11 Patriot Act but the kind of total digital unification envisioned by Doge was unprecedented.
paragraphs.zh: 自“9·11”事件后的《爱国者法案》出台以来，美方就一直在追求数据整合的梦想，但政府效率部所设想的那种全面数字统一是前所未有的。

paragraphs.en: It found its most ambitious expression in the attempt to make all taxpayer data – including names, addresses, social security numbers, tax returns and employment information – accessible from one portal.
paragraphs.zh: 它最雄心勃勃的体现是试图通过一个门户网站获取所有纳税人的数据，包括姓名、地址、社会安全号码、纳税申报单和就业信息。

paragraphs.en: The analogy to Silicon Valley platforms was deliberate. Uber had its "God View", letting employees watch every ride in real time.
paragraphs.zh: 这种与硅谷平台的类比是经过深思熟虑的。优步有它的“上帝视角”，能让员工实时查看每一次行程。

paragraphs.en: When Musk was buying Twitter, he demanded access to the platform's "firehose" – the unfiltered stream of all user activity.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克在收购推特时，要求获取该平台的“数据流”——即所有用户活动的未经过滤的信息流。

paragraphs.en: Now the same principle was being applied to the state.
paragraphs.zh: 现在同样的原则正被应用于国家。

paragraphs.en: Peter Thiel's data integration and analytics company Palantir was a major partner in this undertaking.
paragraphs.zh: 彼得·泰尔的数据集成与分析公司帕兰提尔是这项任务的主要合作伙伴。

paragraphs.en: The company received more than $113m in government contracts in the first months of the Trump administration for work that included making it easier to integrate information from different agencies.
paragraphs.zh: 在特朗普政府执政的头几个月里，该公司获得了超过1.13亿美元的政府合同，所承担的工作包括让不同机构之间的信息整合变得更加容易。

paragraphs.en: Pooling data meant eliminating the legal and privacy guardrails that existed throughout the federal government. Silos are not necessarily bad things. They are spaces of privileged information.
paragraphs.zh: 数据整合意味着要消除联邦政府内部存在的法律和隐私方面的限制。信息孤岛未必是坏事，它们是信息的专属空间。

paragraphs.en: The barriers between them can be safeguards – checks against overreach, misuse and surveillance.
paragraphs.zh: 他们之间的这些障碍可以成为保障措施——防止越权、滥用职权和监视。

paragraphs.en: But from the perspective of Doge, they were obstacles to integration.
paragraphs.zh: 但从政府效率部的角度来看，它们是整合的障碍。

paragraphs.en: Such integration also made it easier to introduce AI software, another priority for Doge.
paragraphs.zh: 这种整合也让引入人工智能软件变得更加容易，这是政府效率部的另一项优先事项。

paragraphs.en: To train AI models, and to use them to replace federal workers, data needed to be centralised and standardised.
paragraphs.zh: 为了训练人工智能模型，并利用它们取代联邦工作人员，数据需要集中化和标准化。

paragraphs.en: At the Department of Veteran Affairs, Doge deployed an AI script to cancel unnecessary contracts.
paragraphs.zh: 在美国退伍军人事务部，政府效率部部署了一个AI脚本以取消不必要的合同。

paragraphs.en: (The model hallucinated, mistaking contracts worth thousands for those worth millions of dollars.)
paragraphs.zh: 该模型产生了幻觉，将价值数千美元的合同误认为价值数百万美元的合同。

paragraphs.en: Doge also used AI to locate "diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI)" language in government policies and programmes.
paragraphs.zh: 政府效率部还利用人工智能来定位政府政策和项目中的"多样性、公平性、包容性"相关表述。

paragraphs.en: Most startlingly, in July 2025, Doge's operatives announced the rollout of the "Doge AI Deregulation Decision Tool", which they promised would cut 100,000 federal regulations within six months.
paragraphs.zh: 最令人震惊的是，2025年7月，政府效率部的运营团队宣布推出"DogeAI去监管决策工具"，并承诺将在六个月内削减10万项联邦法规。

paragraphs.en: They vowed to save 93% of the human labour involved in eliminating regulations by automating away the most time-consuming aspect: namely, reviewing comments submitted by American citizens.
paragraphs.zh: 他们发誓要通过自动化处理最耗时的环节——即审查美国公民提交的意见，来节省消除监管规定过程中93% 的人力劳动。

paragraphs.en: They boasted that hundreds of thousands of comments could be analysed by AI almost instantly.
paragraphs.zh: 他们吹嘘说，人工智能几乎可以即时分析数十万条评论。

paragraphs.en: Doge's endpoint was governance by AI: the state not as a space of deliberation but as lines of executable code.
paragraphs.zh: 政府效率部的目标是实现人工智能治理：国家不再是一个供人商议的场所，而是一串可执行的代码。

paragraphs.en: Musk reinforced the conceit with a "tech support" T-shirt at cabinet meetings, presenting his role in apolitical terms. But the project was deeply political.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克在内阁会议上穿着印有“技术支持”字样的T恤，强化了这种自负感，还以非政治的措辞来描述自己的角色。但这个项目具有深刻的政治意义。

paragraphs.en: Doge's dream of data omniscience went beyond cost-benefit analysis or software modernisation – those had been mantras of earlier administrations.
paragraphs.zh: 政府效率部对数据全知的梦想超越了成本效益分析或软件现代化——这些曾是早期政府的管理口号。

paragraphs.en: For Doge, the hunt for "waste, fraud and abuse" blurred seamlessly into the hunt for illegitimate people: irregularities to be deleted. Muskism was not just about trimming budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 对于政府效率部来说，对"浪费、欺诈和滥用"的追查，无缝衔接地变成了对不合法人群的追查：那些不规范的人要被清除。马斯克主义不仅仅是削减预算那么简单。

paragraphs.en: Scaled to society, it meant purging those deemed out of place.
paragraphs.zh: 在社会层面，这意味着清除那些被认为不合时宜的人。
